living.title: 墨紫会客厅

Fully redesigned intimate smoked-walnut residence, editorial architectural photography, 1536x1024 landscape native output. Purple belongs to ARCHITECTURE, never purple accent furniture. Deep aubergine must read as subtly purple-brown in daylight, not simply gray. Public and sleeping rooms DARK smoked walnut STRAIGHT PLANK floors. Wet rooms brown-black stone. Rich clear daylight exposes grain and lacquer texture, professional balanced exposure, dark but legible, never black void. Completely redesigned furniture, cabinetry, lighting, styling. Restrained fine home craftsmanship, believable compact dimensions. No white/cream sofa, no white/cream large wall or ceiling, no white marble, no pastel lavender, no purple LED, no wallpaper motifs, no garish gold, no generic hotel art, no people, no text, no watermark. Input image 1 is STRUCTURAL REFERENCE ONLY: preserve original straight rectangular footprint, camera, wall and doorway positions, compact living with dining visible behind, TV wall left and sofa right. Totally replace original furnishings/materials: continuous flat near-black aubergine media wall on left, TV flush mounted amid discreet flush integrated cabinetry, walnut lower storage; right wall a broad matte aubergine panel field with selected espresso walnut sections; saddle-brown low compact leather sofa, monolithic rectangular brown-black stone coffee table, dark charcoal-brown woven rug. Behind sofa area, dining has espresso walnut table and chairs backed by large aubergine built-in full-height cabinetry framing one sparse walnut display niche, one singular sculptural art object. No paintings. Flat dark warm taupe ceiling with discreet bronze downlights and one minimal bronze pendant over dining. Floor visible left and foreground is dark straight walnut planks. Wide daylight entering from behind camera. This is a radical redesign, not a recolor.
